policy: Structure IDs reference fixed anchors from the capital, project, skill, and support manifests; town plans never duplicate placement transforms.
Every capital and project town uses explicitly authored blocks, streets, plazas, terrain seams, pedestrian loops, and entrances.
Primary streets follow terrain contours; stairs and retaining seams mark authored grade changes instead of hiding them behind universal pads.
Every retained structure belongs to one block and has one entrance on a closed pedestrian loop.
Low-rise support instances form block edges and service courts without adding evidence claims or procedural placement.
Infrastructure presentation follows the centralized semantic LOD policy and never changes water state, water assets, or LOD thresholds.
